paper_metadata.title: Mechanical characteristics and bioactivity of porous Ni50−xTi50Cux (x = 0, 5 and 10) prepared by P/M

evidence.quote: The present research work investigates and analyses the effect of compaction pressure, sintering temperature and time on mechanical characteristics, namely compressive strength and Young's modulus of Ni50−xTi50Cux (x = 0, 5 and 10) alloys fabricated using powder metallurgy technology.

Three sets of homogeneous powdered mixtures were prepared as Ni50Ti50, Ni45Ti50Cu5 and Ni40Ti50Cu10.

Titanium powder (average size ∼35μm, purity >98.5%) and Nickel powder (average size∼20μm, purity >99.8%) were initially blended for 4h in a rotary ball mill using steatite ceramic ball to mix two powders homogenously.
In the present work, the complete powder mixtures in appropriate compositions were blended in a rotating ball mill for 8h.
